mission_01: sklearn Pipelines chain multiple data processing steps and a final estimator into a single object that can be treated like any other estimator. The pipeline applies each transformation step sequentially, passing the output of one step as input to the next. This design prevents data leakage by ensuring that transformations are fit only on training data and then applied to test data using the same parameters. Pipelines simplify code by replacing multiple fit/transform calls with a single fit/predict call. They also make it easy to experiment with different preprocessing combinations and enable hyperparameter tuning across all steps using the step__parameter naming convention. Pipelines are the foundation of reproducible machine learning workflows in sklearn.
